data.stimulus: Press Agree to participate in the experiment.

Welcome to the Study!

In this study, you will complete 4 brief sessions, each featuring a different task.

Before we begin, please read the following scenario carefully.

Scenario:

Imagine that you work for a web design agency.
Your client, SS Realty Group, is creating a web brochure for their newly opened condominium.
They have asked you to include photos of the model bedrooms in the brochure.
To meet this request, your photography team has prepared two sets of bedroom images, called Miro and Tavi.

Click the button below to begin Session 1

Session 1

Scenario continued:

Last night, however, the Miro and Tavi image folders were accidentally merged.
The photography team has asked you to help sort the images back into their correct folders.
They cannot easily describe the difference between the two sets, but they can provide feedback as you classify each image.

Press 'e' for Miro and 'i' for Tavi

In this session, you will see a series of images one at a time.
For each image, decide which set it belongs to by pressing either 'e' or 'i'.

After each response, you will receive feedback indicating whether your response was correct or wrong.
Use this feedback to sort as many images correctly as possible.

Please try to respond as accurately and quickly as possible.
If you do not responded within 2 seconds, it will automatically move on to the next image.

You will classify 108 images across 6 rounds.
